speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin; have you noticed if the yellow color is spreading to your legs or if your baby is acting lethargic? To better assess the severity, can you tell me how old your baby is in hours or days?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic Jaundice). The clinical picture of a healthy, full-term 2-week-old female with increasing but stable weight gain and exclusive breastfeeding is most consistent with suboptimal milk intake leading to dehydration and prolonged enterohepatic circulation of bilirubin.
